integrity: Proof supplied in full, numerical checks are supplementary; earlier two-atom single-mode formula and quarter comparison are acknowledged as prior.
limitations: Exact-arithmetic, fixed-parameter, local spectral result for strictly positive rectangular entropic transport with n>=m+2; no global/homotopy guarantee, no uniform prefactor-one rate at defective roots, and bibliographic nonoverlap limited by accessible literature.
title: Zero-mode bottlenecks change optimal local Acc-Sinkhorn tuning for rectangular transport
